collection.title: Vauxhall Zafira Zafira Tourer 2012 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Zafira Tourer 2012 Onwards model requires a 32" wiper blade for the drivers and a 28" on the passengers side with a Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Zafira Tourer which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
